dod.title: Normal Leave
dod.flow: Submit → correct approvers → correct WF → correct OD → signature حسب السياسة → permanent download → archive → tasks closed → notification correct

dod.title: Travel Leave
dod.flow: Travel clearly selected → correct travel routing → PRO/government stage حسب Business Rule فقط → no ambiguity

dod.title: Salary Certificate
dod.flow: خيار واحد فقط → approval chain الصحيحة → correct document → signatory policy → permanent download → archive

dod.title: Signature Replacement
dod.flow: reason required → pending → old remains active → HR approve/reject → correct new version/history/audit

dod.title: Residency Renewal
dod.flow: expiry → one task → contract → employee signature → government processing → final docs → OCR success OR manual fallback → gov data → HR verification → completed → new expiry everywhere → old tasks/reminders closed

dod.title: Document Renewal
dod.flow: old current → replacement → new current → old previous version → expiry engine watches new only

dod.title: Tasks/Notifications
dod.flow: actionable tasks only in count → digest doesn't inflate → completed/cancelled leaves no stale action

dod.title: Cross-company PRO
dod.flow: switch GUF/MUF → every selected-company counter/list consistent → global items clearly labeled

dod.title: Archived Employee
dod.flow: cannot submit → no attendance action → no recurring work notifications → retention per policy only

dod.title: Exit/EOS
dod.flow: one connected case from resignation/termination through settlement/clearance/archive/access closure

dod.title: Storage
dod.flow: generate several official documents → redeploy/restart → every document remains downloadable

dod.title: Counters
dod.flow: every Dashboard/Card number manually reconciled with rows opened from it

guardrails: Multi-company architecture intentional
Owner portfolio / All Companies visibility intentional حسب الصلاحية
PRO/Delegate assigned GUF + MUF يجوز له العمل في الاثنين
Secondary PRO assignment لا تدخل Payroll/EOS/financial employee counts
PRO يرى البيانات الحكومية اللازمة وليس Payroll/private HR data
Employee leave-date privacy الحالية intentional
Branch Supervisor salary/documents visibility accepted
Manager Users/Permissions داخل شركته accepted
Super Admin ليس مطلوبا منه رؤية كل requests
Government Links للـPRO/Delegate فقط
Normal Leave لا يدخل PRO
Government official documents لا يصدرها النظام بدل الجهة
closure-check في Residency Renewal يظل mandatory
OCR low confidence لا يعمل silent authoritative update
Current/Previous Document Versions behavior الحالي يحافظ عليه
2FA behavior الحالي intentional للأدوار المعتمدة
Auto Logout ~10 دقائق للأدوار الحساسة intentional
Signature replacement: old signature remains active until approval
First Login/password behavior للحسابات الحقيقية لا نعيد تغييره
لا نغيّر Payroll/RBAC أثناء Operational Cleanup إلا بـFinding مثبت وموافق عليه
